data.narrative:
Emerald AI is a Seed-stage climate and energy technology company founded by Varun Sivaram. The company has raised $68M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises nine same-sector companies, including eight private firms (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and others) and one public comparable (LNZA).

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($68M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $170M. Peer-median analysis is not reliable here: while nine Climate & Energy peers exist, none of the narrow peer sets (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier private companies) produced three or more datapoints, and a broad all-sector median would introduce undue noise.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, centered at $170M. This range reflects moderate confidence in the stage-progression method applied to the $68M baseline. Key uncertainties include the robustness of the 2.5x multiplier assumption for this specific sector and stage, and the absence of tightly comparable Seed-stage peers in the narrow Climate & Energy frontier-tech market. Revenue visibility and competitive positioning within the energy transition space would materially affect positioning within the range.
